services.name: boat rental
services.desc: We offer a wide variety of premier boating services across our marinas. Please contact your local Morningstar Marinas location to see which services are offered. From sunglasses and sunscreen to batteries and life jackets, every location’s Ship’s Store is stocked with supplies, snacks, gifts and everything else you and your boat needs for your day on the water. Our wash, wax and detailing services are designed to keep your boat looking its best. Boat washes thoroughly clean the exterior of your boat while waxing protects your fiberglass from sun damage and oxidation.
